title: Pinout device definition
description: The JSON object produced by evaluating a device Jsonnet file.

models.description: Exact device-tree model or DMI system product names sharing this configuration. Any listed value matches; Description prints the matched value.

connectors.description: Connector IDs or partial connector overrides in display order. Each override's id selects its base connector. The program resolves IDs, merges overrides, and validates the result.
